verses.original: δὲ Συνεργοῦντες καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν ὑμᾶς μὴ δέξασθαι τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν χάριν εἰς κενὸν
verses.transliteration: de Synergountes kai parakaloumen hymas mē dexasthai tou Theou tēn charin eis kenon
verses.literal: [As] [God’s] fellow workers then we urge you not to receive - God’s - grace in vain

verses.original: γάρ λέγει Καιρῷ δεκτῷ ἐπήκουσά σου καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ σωτηρίας ἐβοήθησά σοι Ἰδοὺ νῦν καιρὸς εὐπρόσδεκτος ἰδοὺ νῦν ἡμέρα σωτηρίας
verses.transliteration: gar legei Kairō dektō epēkousa sou kai en hēmera sōtērias eboēthēsa soi Idou nyn kairos euprosdektos idou nyn hēmera sōtērias
verses.literal: For He says In the time of favor I heard you and in [the] day of salvation I helped you Behold now [is the] time of favor - now [is the] day of salvation

verses.original: διδόντες Μηδεμίαν προσκοπήν ἐν μηδενὶ ἵνα μὴ μωμηθῇ ἡ διακονία
verses.transliteration: didontes Mēdemian proskopēn en mēdeni hina mē mōmēthē hē diakonia
verses.literal: We put no obstacle in [anyone’s] {way} so that no one can discredit [our] ministry

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὡς διάκονοι Θεοῦ συνιστάνοντες ἑαυτοὺς ἐν παντὶ ἐν πολλῇ ὑπομονῇ ἐν θλίψεσιν ἐν ἀνάγκαις ἐν στενοχωρίαις
verses.transliteration: all’ hōs diakonoi Theou synistanontes heautous en panti en pollē hypomonē en thlipsesin en anankais en stenochōriais
verses.literal: Rather as servants of God we commend ourselves in every way in great endurance in troubles - hardships [and] calamities

verses.original: ἐν πληγαῖς ἐν φυλακαῖς ἐν ἀκαταστασίαις ἐν κόποις ἐν ἀγρυπνίαις ἐν νηστείαις
verses.transliteration: en plēgais en phylakais en akatastasiais en kopois en agrypniais en nēsteiais
verses.literal: in beatings - imprisonments - [and] riots in labor - sleepless nights - [and] hunger

verses.original: ἐν ἁγνότητι ἐν γνώσει ἐν μακροθυμίᾳ ἐν χρηστότητι ἐν Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι ἐν ἀνυποκρίτῳ ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: en hagnotēti en gnōsei en makrothymia en chrēstotēti en Hagiō Pneumati en anypokritō agapē
verses.literal: in purity - knowledge - patience [and] kindness in [the] Holy Spirit [and] in sincere love

verses.original: ἐν ἀληθείας λόγῳ ἐν δυνάμει Θεοῦ διὰ τῶν ὅπλων τῆς δικαιοσύνης τῶν δεξιῶν καὶ ἀριστερῶν
verses.transliteration: en alētheias logō en dynamei Theou dia tōn hoplōn tēs dikaiosynēs tōn dexiōn kai aristerōn
verses.literal: in truthful speech [and] in [the] power of God with the weapons - of righteousness in the right hand and in [the] left

verses.original: διὰ δόξης καὶ ἀτιμίας διὰ δυσφημίας καὶ εὐφημίας ὡς πλάνοι καὶ ἀληθεῖς
verses.transliteration: dia doxēs kai atimias dia dysphēmias kai euphēmias hōs planoi kai alētheis
verses.literal: through glory and dishonor - slander and praise viewed as imposters yet genuine

verses.original: ὡς ἀγνοούμενοι καὶ ἐπιγινωσκόμενοι ὡς ἀποθνήσκοντες καὶ ἰδοὺ ζῶμεν ὡς παιδευόμενοι καὶ μὴ θανατούμενοι
verses.transliteration: hōs agnooumenoi kai epiginōskomenoi hōs apothnēskontes kai idou zōmen hōs paideuomenoi kai mē thanatoumenoi
verses.literal: vvv unknown yet well-known - dying and yet - we live on - punished yet vvv not killed

verses.original: ὡς λυπούμενοι δὲ ἀεὶ χαίροντες ὡς πτωχοὶ δὲ πολλοὺς πλουτίζοντες ὡς ἔχοντες μηδὲν καὶ κατέχοντες πάντα
verses.transliteration: hōs lypoumenoi de aei chairontes hōs ptōchoi de pollous ploutizontes hōs echontes mēden kai katechontes panta
verses.literal: - sorrowful yet always rejoicing - poor yet {making} many rich - having nothing and yet possessing everything

verses.original: Τὸ ἡμῶν στόμα ἀνέῳγεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς Κορίνθιοι ἡμῶν ἡ καρδία πεπλάτυνται
verses.transliteration: To hēmōn stoma aneōgen pros hymas Korinthioi hēmōn hē kardia peplatyntai
verses.literal: - We vvv have spoken freely to you Corinthians Our - hearts are open wide

verses.original: δὲ οὐ στενοχωρεῖσθε ἐν ἡμῖν σπλάγχνοις ἐν τοῖς ὑμῶν στενοχωρεῖσθε
verses.transliteration: de ou stenochōreisthe en hēmin splanchnois en tois hymōn stenochōreisthe
verses.literal: [It is] not - vvv our affection [but] - yours that is restrained

verses.original: δὲ τὴν αὐτὴν ἀντιμισθίαν λέγω ὡς τέκνοις πλατύνθητε ὑμεῖς καὶ
verses.transliteration: de tēn autēn antimisthian legō hōs teknois platynthēte hymeis kai
verses.literal: [As] - a fair exchange I speak as to [my] children open wide your [hearts] also

verses.original: Μὴ γίνεσθε ἑτεροζυγοῦντες ἀπίστοις γὰρ τίς μετοχὴ δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ἀνομίᾳ ἢ τίς κοινωνία φωτὶ πρὸς σκότος
verses.transliteration: Mē ginesthe heterozygountes apistois gar tis metochē dikaiosynē kai anomia ē tis koinōnia phōti pros skotos
verses.literal: {Do} not be unequally yoked with unbelievers For what partnership [can] righteousness [have with] wickedness Or what fellowship [does] light [have] with darkness

verses.original: δὲ τίς συμφώνησις Χριστοῦ πρὸς Βελιάρ ἢ τίς πιστῷ μερὶς μετὰ ἀπίστου
verses.transliteration: de tis symphōnēsis Christou pros Belial ē tis pistō meris meta apistou
verses.literal: - What harmony [is there between] Christ and Belial Or what {does} a believer have in common with an unbeliever

verses.original: δὲ τίς συνκατάθεσις μετὰ ναῷ Θεοῦ εἰδώλων γὰρ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν ναὸς ζῶντος Θεοῦ καθὼς ὁ Θεὸς εἶπεν ὅτι Ἐνοικήσω ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐμπεριπατήσω καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτῶν Θεός καὶ αὐτοὶ ἔσονταί μου λαός
verses.transliteration: de tis synkatathesis meta naō Theou eidōlōn gar hēmeis esmen naos zōntos Theou kathōs ho Theos eipen hoti Enoikēsō en autois kai emperipatēsō kai esomai autōn Theos kai autoi esontai mou laos
verses.literal: - What agreement [can exist] between the temple of God [and] idols For we are [the] temple of [the] living God As - God has said - I will dwell with them and walk among [them] and I will be their God and they will be My people

verses.original: Διὸ ἐξέλθατε ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν καὶ ἀφορίσθητε λέγει Κύριος καὶ ἅπτεσθε μὴ ἀκαθάρτου κἀγὼ εἰσδέξομαι ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Dio exelthate ek mesou autōn kai aphoristhēte legei Kyrios kai haptesthe mē akathartou kagō eisdexomai hymas
verses.literal: Therefore come out from . . . among them and be separate says [the] Lord - Touch no unclean {thing} and I will receive you

verses.original: Καὶ Ἔσομαι εἰς Πατέρα ὑμῖν καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔσεσθέ εἰς μοι υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας λέγει Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ
verses.transliteration: Kai Esomai eis Patera hymin kai hymeis esesthe eis moi huious kai thygateras legei Kyrios Pantokratōr
verses.literal: And I will be - a Father to you and you will be - My sons and daughters says [the] Lord Almighty
